changeSet.author: emcip
changeSet.comment: Change embedding columns from 1536 (OpenAI default) to 1024 (bge-m3). Drops and recreates IVFFlat indexes since ALTER COLUMN TYPE invalidates them.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ke_knowledge_documents ALTER COLUMN embedding TYPE vector(1024);
ALTER TABLE ke_graph_node_embeddings ALTER COLUMN embedding TYPE vector(1024);
CREATE INDEX idx_ke_docs_embedding ON ke_knowledge_documents USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);
CREATE INDEX idx_ke_node_emb_vector ON ke_graph_node_embeddings USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (lists = 100);
